AURORAMOD-HEAT_POWER.title: Heat
AURORAMOD-HEAT_POWER.description: Cold 0-3 / Warm 4-6 / Overload 7+ (your Attacks deal 25% more; 10+ is still Overload). At 10 you trigger an Overheat: lock in the Overheat damage, then at end of turn take it (blockable), reset Heat, and gain 1 System Crash next turn. Venting lowers Heat but not the locked Overheat damage; waived on victory.
AURORAMOD-HEAT_POWER.smartDescription: Cold 0-3 / Warm 4-6 / Overload 7+ (Attacks +25%). At 10 you trigger an Overheat; end of turn take {NextOverheatDamage} blockable damage and reset.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SYSTEM_CRASH_PENDING_PO: Hidden counter. At the start of your next turn, add this many System Crash cards to your hand, then clear this counter.
Gain this many System Crash cards at the start of your next turn.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_OVERHEAT_COUNT_POWER.de: Hidden counter. Tracks how many times you have Overheated this combat. The 1st/2nd/3rd/4th and later Overheats deal 10/12/14/16 blockable damage.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_OVERHEAT_COUNT_POWER.sm: Overheats this combat; this count determines your next Overheat damage.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SYSTEM_CRASH_PENALTY_PO: Hidden power. While at least 1 System Crash is in your hand, your Attacks deal 25% less damage. Multiple copies do not stack; non-Attack damage from Modules, Skills, Relics, and Status cards is unaffected.
Attacks deal 25% less while a System Crash is in your hand; multiple copies do not stack.
AURORAMOD-MOMENTUM_POWER.title: Momentum
AURORAMOD-MOMENTUM_POWER.description: Every 3 Momentum increases your Attack damage by 1, up to +5. Momentum has no cap and does not decay on its own; only effects that explicitly say 'clear all Momentum' consume all stacks, and effects that merely read Momentum do not consume it.
AURORAMOD-MOMENTUM_POWER.smartDescriptio: Every 3 Momentum grants +1 Attack damage (up to +5); no cap and does not decay, only 'clear all Momentum' consumes all stacks.
AURORAMOD-ATTACK_MODULE_POWER.title: Attack Module
AURORAMOD-ATTACK_MODULE_POWER.descriptio: A deployed floating module. Attack and Shield Modules share 2 base slots, which Auxiliary Hardpoint can expand to 3; deploying while full requires you to choose a module to replace. At the end of your turn, this module deals #{Value} damage to an enemy, prioritizing living enemies with the most Lock applied by you; ties or no Lock are resolved randomly. This damage can trigger and consume your Lock. Each enhancement increases its damage by 1. Module damage is not increased by Overload and does not advance Chain.
AURORAMOD-ATTACK_MODULE_POWER.smartDescr: End of turn: deal #{Value} damage, prioritizing the enemy with the most Lock applied by you; can trigger Lock.
AURORAMOD-SHIELD_MODULE_POWER.title: Shield Module
AURORAMOD-SHIELD_MODULE_POWER.descriptio: A deployed floating module. Shield and Attack Modules share 2 base slots, which Auxiliary Hardpoint can expand to 3; deploying while full requires you to choose a module to replace. At the start of your turn, this module grants #{Value} Block; card effects that 'trigger a Shield Module' perform the same effect. Each enhancement increases its Block by 1.
AURORAMOD-SHIELD_MODULE_POWER.smartDescr: Start of turn: gain #{Value} Block; triggering this module grants the same Block.
AURORAMOD-CHALLENGE_PROTOCOL_POWER.title: Challenge Protocol
AURORAMOD-CHALLENGE_PROTOCOL_POWER.descr: A positive buff applied to this enemy by an Aurora, so Artifact does not block it. Each Aurora tracks her own stacks, up to 3 on the same enemy. Each stack increases this enemy's Attack damage against the Aurora who applied it by 10% (1/2/3 stacks = x1.10/x1.20/x1.30); redirected damage against an ally does not carry this bonus. Challenge Protocol grants no reward by itself. Only card text that explicitly uses it provides a reward. It does not decay and disappears only when explicitly consumed, the enemy dies, or combat ends.
AURORAMOD-CHALLENGE_PROTOCOL_POWER.smart: This enemy's Attacks deal 10% more damage per stack against the Aurora who applied it, up to 3 stacks; does not decay.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_LOCK_CONSUME_POWER.desc: Internal hidden power. When your Attack or Attack Module produces a valid positive damage segment against an enemy, even if fully Blocked, consume 1 of your Lock on that enemy and let the Lock damage center add its bonus.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_LOCK_CONSUME_POWER.smar: Attacks and Attack Modules consume your Lock on hit.
AURORAMOD-LOCK_POWER.title: Lock
AURORAMOD-LOCK_POWER.description: A debuff applied to this enemy by an Aurora; Artifact can block it. Each Aurora tracks her own stacks, up to 6 on the same enemy. When the applier hits this enemy with an Attack or her own Attack Module, each damage segment consumes 1 Lock and adds 2 damage after Strength, Vulnerable, Overload, and other multipliers; this +2 is not multiplied again and is still affected by Block and final damage caps. At end of turn, Attack Modules prioritize living enemies with the most Lock applied by their owner; ties are random. Lock does not decay and disappears only when consumed, the enemy dies, or combat ends.
AURORAMOD-LOCK_POWER.smartDescription: The applying Aurora holds up to 6 stacks that do not decay; her Attacks and Attack Modules consume 1 per segment for +2 damage, and her Modules prioritize the enemy with the most Lock she applied.
AURORAMOD-CHAIN_POWER.title: Chain
AURORAMOD-CHAIN_POWER.description: Activates after you manually play 3 cards this turn and lasts until end of turn; cards played after the third card count as Chained. Autoplayed cards, copied resolutions, and extra resolutions do not advance the count. Only effects that explicitly mention Chained gain a bonus.
AURORAMOD-CHAIN_POWER.smartDescription: Activates after manually playing 3 cards; cards played afterward are Chained until end of turn.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MODULE_CAPACITY_POWER.d: This combat, increase the shared slot limit for your Attack and Shield Modules by #{Extra}. The base limit is 2 and the hard cap is 3; repeated applications cannot exceed 3. The third slot participates normally in all deploy, replace, enhance, trigger, rotate, and recall effects.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MODULE_CAPACITY_POWER.s: +#{Extra} Module slot this combat; base 2, maximum 3.
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-HEAT.title: Heat
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-HEAT.description: Cold 0-3 / Warm 4-6 / Overload 7+ (Attacks deal 25% more). At 10 you trigger an Overheat: at end of turn take the locked blockable damage, reset Heat to 0, and gain a System Crash next turn. Venting lowers Heat but not the locked Overheat damage.
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-SYSTEM_CRASH.title: System Crash
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-SYSTEM_CRASH.descripti: Unplayable; while in hand your Attacks deal 25% less (does not stack), consumed at end of turn.
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-ATTACK_MODULE.title: Attack Module
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-ATTACK_MODULE.descript: A floating module. At end of turn it deals its current value, prioritizing the enemy with the most Lock you applied. Shares 2 slots with Shield Modules (up to 3); deploying while full replaces one.
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-SHIELD_MODULE.title: Shield Module
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-SHIELD_MODULE.descript: A floating module. At the start of your turn it grants Block equal to its value. Shares 2 slots with Attack Modules (up to 3); deploying while full replaces one.
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-MODULE_CAPACITY.title: Module Slots
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-MODULE_CAPACITY.descri: Attack and Shield Modules share slots, 2 by default; Auxiliary Hardpoint raises the cap to 3 this combat.
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-MODULE_ENHANCEMENT.des: Each Enhancement gives the chosen module +1 damage or Block. Unless a card says 'all Modules', only one is affected.
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-LOCK.title: Lock
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-LOCK.description: A debuff you apply to an enemy, up to 6 stacks. Each of your Attack or Attack Module hits consumes 1 and adds 2 damage; Attack Modules prioritize the enemy with the most Lock you applied. Does not decay.
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-CHAIN.title: Chain
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-CHAIN.description: After you manually play 3 cards this turn you become Chained until end of turn. Autoplays, copies, and extra resolutions do not count.
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-MOMENTUM.title: Momentum
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-MOMENTUM.description: Every 3 Momentum grants +1 Attack damage, up to +5. No cap and does not decay; only 'clear all Momentum' spends it all, merely reading Momentum does not.
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-CHALLENGE_PROTOCOL.des: A mark you apply to an enemy, up to 3 stacks. Each stack makes that enemy's Attacks deal 10% more to you. Grants nothing by itself-only cards that use it pay out.
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-SCAN.title: Scan
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-SCAN.description: Look at the top N cards of your draw pile; you may move any of them to the discard. Not counted as drawing or discarding; the rest keep their order.
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-ZONE_CHANGE.title: Zone Change
AURORAMOD-TOOLTIP-ZONE_CHANGE.descriptio: When one Heat change moves you between Cold/Warm/Overload zones, that counts as 1 zone change (even if it crosses several).
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ATTACK_TURN_TRACKER.des: Internal hidden power. Tracks whether you have played an Attack this turn (including autoplayed ones), for effects that check "if you have not played an Attack this turn." Resets at turn start.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ATTACK_TURN_TRACKER.sma: Tracks whether you have played an Attack this turn.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BURNING_ADVANCE_TURN_PO: Whether this turn's Burning Advance return has been used.
Whether this turn's Burning Advance return has been used.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_PILEDRIVER_DISC: After Overheating this combat, Reactor Piledriver costs no more than 1.
After Overheating this combat, Reactor Piledriver costs no more than 1.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RESIDUAL_ARMOR_POWER.de: The first time you Overheat each turn, gain {Amount} Block before Overheat damage.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RESIDUAL_ARMOR_POWER.sm: The first time you Overheat each turn, gain {Amount} Block before Overheat damage.
Overheat locked in: at end of turn take {LockedDamage} blockable damage, reset Heat, and gain 1 System Crash next turn. Venting will not reduce this damage; waived on victory.
End of turn Overheat: take {LockedDamage} blockable damage (venting won't reduce it).
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PHASE_SHIELD_POWER.desc: The first time you change Heat zones each turn, gain {Amount} Block. Heat changes within Redline are not zone changes; Overheat reset does not trigger it.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PHASE_SHIELD_POWER.smar: The first time you change zones each turn, gain {Amount} Block.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COOLING_CYCLE_POWER.des: The first time you actually Vent Heat each turn, draw {DrawCount} card(s) and gain {TriggerBlock} Block. Overheat reset does not count as Venting.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COOLING_CYCLE_POWER.sma: The first time you actually Vent each turn, draw {DrawCount} and gain {TriggerBlock} Block.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHARGING_STANCE_POWER.d: Each Attack you play adds {Amount} Heat.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COMMAND_CACHE_POWER.des: The first time you become Chained each turn, draw {DrawCount} cards, gain {BlockOnTrigger} Block and add {HeatOnTrigger} Heat.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COMMAND_CACHE_POWER.sma: The first time you become Chained each turn, draw {DrawCount} cards.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SENTRY_ARRAY_POWER.desc: The first time you successfully Deploy a Module each turn, the new Module gains {Amount} Enhancement and triggers once.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SENTRY_ARRAY_POWER.smar: The first Module you Deploy each turn gains {Amount} Enhancement and triggers once.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SELF_HARM_TRACKER_POWER: Hidden counter. Tracks HP you have actually lost this combat to your own cards or Overheat, read by Limit Fracture.
HP actually lost this combat to your own cards or Overheat.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_ROUTING_POWER.d: At the start of your turn, based on your Heat zone: Cold {ColdBlock} Block / Warm draw {WarmDraw} / Overload {OverloadEnergy} Energy, then gain {OverloadHeat} Heat. Stacks linearly (your zone is checked once at the start of turn; the Overload branch gains all Energy first, then gains Heat once).
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_ROUTING_POWER.s: Turn start, by Heat zone (stacks add up): Cold gain {ColdBlock} Block / Warm draw {WarmDraw} / Overload gain {OverloadEnergy} Energy and {OverloadHeat} Heat.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_OVERCLOCK_POWER.title: Overclock
AURORAMOD-AURORA_OVERCLOCK_POWER.descrip: While you are in Overload AND have a pending Overheat, each stack gives your Attacks +75% final damage (at 7-9 Heat with no pending Overheat, only the base x1.25 applies; venting out of Overload stops the bonus, but the pending Overheat is not cancelled). When Overheat resolves, take no Overheat damage; instead lose 2 Max HP per stack. If your Max HP is too low to pay, take the locked Overheat damage instead. Waived on victory. Heat is still cleared and System Crash added.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_OVERCLOCK_POWER.smartDe: In Overload with a pending Overheat, Attacks gain +75% per stack; Overheat costs 2 Max HP per stack instead (if your Max HP is too low, take the damage as usual).
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BURIAL_FURNACE_POWER.de: Whenever Overheat finishes resolving and you are still alive, gain {Amount} Strength.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BURIAL_FURNACE_POWER.sm: Gain {Amount} Strength after each Overheat resolves (if alive).
{Amount} charges left. When your own card or Overheat would reduce your HP to 0, consume 1 charge to remain at 1 HP and gain {EnergyGain} Energy (next turn if outside your action phase). Does not stop enemy attacks.
Self/Overheat lethal: consume 1 charge to stay at 1 HP and gain {EnergyGain} Energy. {Amount} left.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_AUTONOMOUS_ARSENAL_POWE: At the end of your turn, if your Module slots are full, trigger all Modules {Amount} additional round(s), gaining 1 Heat each round.
End of turn at full slots: trigger all Modules {Amount} extra round(s) and gain Heat.
The first {Amount} time(s) each turn you Rotate or successfully replace a Module at full slots, give the resulting Module 3 Enhancement and trigger it once. (A full-slot replacement also counts as a deploy, so it can trigger Sentry Array as well.)
First {Amount} Rotate/full-replace each turn: that Module +3 Enhancement and trigger once.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_TRI_PHASE_COMMAND_CORE_: When Chain activates each turn, trigger by current Heat zone (once per stack): in Cold gain {MomentumPerStack} Momentum; in Warm give the least-enhanced Module {EnhancePerStack} Enhancement; in Overload trigger all Modules once.
On Chain activation, by Heat zone (once per stack): Cold gain {MomentumPerStack} Momentum / Warm +{EnhancePerStack} Enhancement to one Module / Overload trigger all Modules once.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOMENTUM_RESONANCE_POWE: At the start of your turn, if you have less than {Threshold} Momentum, gain {MomentumGain} Momentum; otherwise draw {Amount} cards.
Turn start: Momentum under {Threshold} gain {MomentumGain}, else draw {Amount}.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_TEMPERING_POWER: Whenever an Overheat finishes resolving and you are still alive, gain {Amount} Momentum.
Gain {Amount} Momentum after each Overheat resolves (if alive).
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SCABBARD_ARMED_POWER.de: Internal hidden marker. Tracks whether Heat-Lined Scabbard's start-of-combat bonus was granted this combat, so reconnecting does not grant it twice.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SCABBARD_ARMED_POWER.sm: Whether Heat-Lined Scabbard fired this combat.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COUPLER_USED_POWER.desc: Internal hidden marker. Tracks whether Full-Load Coupler triggered this combat, so reconnecting does not trigger it twice.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COUPLER_USED_POWER.smar: Whether Full-Load Coupler fired this combat.
Internal hidden marker. Tracks per-kind whether each event preload was granted this combat, so reconnecting does not grant it twice.
Whether each event preload fired this combat.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_TURN_GATE_POWER.title: Turn Gate
AURORAMOD-AURORA_TURN_GATE_POWER.descrip: Internal hidden marker. Bitmask tracking which once-per-turn abilities already fired this turn, so reconnecting does not fire them twice. Cleared at the start of each turn.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_TURN_GATE_POWER.smartDe: Which once-per-turn abilities already fired this turn.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHASSIS_USED_POWER.desc: Internal hidden counter. Tracks how many times Adaptive Chassis fired this turn, so reconnecting does not exceed the per-turn limit. Cleared at the start of each turn.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHASSIS_USED_POWER.smar: Adaptive Chassis uses spent this turn.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COOLING_CYCLE_BONUS_POW: Internal hidden marker. Stores the accumulated upgrade Block that Cooling Cycle grants on trigger, kept in serialized state so it survives reconnect.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COMMAND_CACHE_BONUS_POW: Internal hidden marker. Stores the accumulated upgrade Block and Heat that Command Cache grants on trigger, kept in serialized state so it survives reconnect.
Command Cache's stored trigger Block and Heat.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ASHEN_DEFERRED_ENERGY_P: Internal hidden marker. Stores the Energy Ashen Rekindling owes when it triggered outside your action phase, kept in serialized state so it survives reconnect and is paid at the start of your next turn.
Energy Ashen Rekindling will grant next turn.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_LOCKED_OVERHEAT_DAMAGE_: Internal hidden marker. Stores the peak Overheat damage locked in while an Overheat is pending, so venting cannot reduce the debt. Kept in serialized state for reconnect consistency; read at settlement.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REDUNDANT_PLATING_POWER: At the start of your turn, your Block is no longer cleared; you retain half of it (rounded down) instead.
Retain half your Block at the start of your turn.
